channel.title: RideMeme Digest — Philippine & world motoring
channel.description: The day's top Philippine and world motoring stories, auto-curated.

item.title: Geely, NIO seal power pact
item.description: Geely Holding Group and NIO have agreed to invest in each other’s energy businesses as the two Chinese automakers work toward a shared network of electric vehicle charging and battery-swapping stations.

item.title: Suzuki upgrades Manila Bay dealership
item.description: Suzuki Philippines has relaunched its Manila Bay dealership in Pasay City with improved showroom and service facilities through its longtime dealer partner, Wheels Inc.

item.title: Green SM goes stateside
item.description: Green SM, the Vietnamese electric taxi operator already operating in the Philippines, has expanded to the United States with the launch of its all-electric taxi service in Los Angeles, California, on 13 October.

item.title: The quiet hustler
item.description: Six days driving the fully electric VinFast VF 5 around Metro Manila made me appreciate the advantages of its compact size, particularly when traffic is heavy and parking lots are limited.

item.title: First dibs: VinFast opens VF 8 bookings in Phl ahead of November launch
item.description: VinFast has opened early bookings for its all-new VF 8 in the Philippines, with the first 1,000 customers who place reservations by 5 November eligible for a free one-year battery subscription ahead of the electric SUV’s official launch later that month.

item.title: Toyota doubles points for TGR Cup finals
item.description: Toyota Motor Philippines (TMP) is holding the fourth and final race weekend of the 2026 TOYOTA GAZOO Racing Philippine Cup season on October 22-24 at the Clark International Speedway in Mabalacat, Pampanga. The event is open to the public and admission is FREE.

item.title: Jump now, deliver later
item.description: A white Tesla Roadster climbed a curved ramp at a SpaceX facility in Texas last Thursday, kept going until it was upside down, then dropped into the air, flipped upright and landed on its wheels.

item.title: Modern Cars Are Ditching The Dipstick: Here's Why
item.description: Digital oil and transmission dipsticks are replacing physical ones at a rapid rate, but why the change to a seemingly more-complicated technology?

item.title: How 'Jam Sandwich' Became Slang For Certain British Police Cars
item.description: Ever been pulled over by a jam sandwich? Learn the origin of this classic UK slang for police cars and the iconic cars behind the look.

item.title: Compared To Its Competitors, The Toyota 4Runner Is Either Archaic Or Civilized
item.description: The 4Runner remains one of the most unique SUVs on the market today, and depending on your needs, it's either absolutely brilliant or stuck decades behind.
